name: eq-piano
description: Warmth without mud, tight lows, clear attack and overtones. Ballad, tight, honky-tonk, and vintage directions.
notes: Precondition: Piano track selected in Cubase, insert 0 loaded per opencode/reference/eq-piano.md.
Send in listed order with unique numeric id per request to POST http://localhost:3001/rpc.
Response param field shows resolved Cubase title; on Parameter not found, shorten spelling.
Mud scoop in the low-mid (~0.4); warmth pillar / attack / overtone shelf manually by resolved title.
Dry by design: no send.set calls; study stays upfront.
